purpose: Compare incumbent repository-native guidance with the same guidance plus a Farna Context materialisation under controlled, independently observable conditions.

frozen_inputs.fixture_revision: synthetic fixture files are versioned with this repository

modulo.status: optional and not implemented until a clean checkout is supplied

A.label: incumbent
A.context_boundary: The isolated checkout exactly as copied from the frozen fixture/repository revision. OpenCode may see only repository-native files and the task input.

B.label: incumbent_plus_farna_context
B.context_boundary: The same isolated checkout and task input as Arm A, plus the generated context-pack.json placed at the recorded pack path.

isolation.fresh_cache_policy: no shared evaluation cache; model/provider caches are recorded and treated as contamination if shared
isolation.network_policy: disabled by default; an explicitly enabled provider/network policy must be recorded
isolation.permission_policy: OpenCode runs with the caller-selected permissions; record the exact policy, never infer it

task_and_scoring.generality_claim: low-generality exploratory result only; one synthetic fixture/task is not a product-wide claim
task_and_scoring.scoring_note: Until the founder freezes the task rubric, scores are recorded as null with status=unfrozen; no outcome ranking is permitted.

run_classification.valid_task_failure: The assigned task was frozen, setup was valid, the provider produced an attempt, contamination checks passed, and the task outcome failed its frozen rubric.
run_classification.valid_task_success: The assigned task was frozen, setup was valid, provider outcome was observed, contamination checks passed, and the task outcome met its frozen rubric.
run_classification.setup_invalidity: Fixture, checkout, protocol, permission, or command setup did not meet the protocol.
run_classification.harness_invalidity: The harness could not produce a trustworthy record, including timeout bookkeeping or failed isolation checks.
run_classification.provider_failure: OpenCode/provider/model could not produce a usable attempt; this is not a task failure.
run_classification.contamination_invalidity: Cross-arm files, outputs, conversation state, cache state, or parent checkout contamination was detected.
run_classification.unobserved: The relevant state was not independently observable; do not turn it into a success or failure claim.

records.result_format: JSONL, one immutable record per arm/attempt
records.summary_format: JSON, generated from result JSONL without changing records
records.secret_policy: Never write secret values, API keys, tokens, credentials, or raw environment dumps. Hashes and redacted command metadata only.
records.delivery_evidence: Record observed commit/diff/test evidence; a model claim or report is not delivery evidence.

runner.stdin: always closed with subprocess.DEVNULL unless an explicit prompt file redirect is used
runner.command: caller-selected OpenCode executable and arguments; no credentials or model keys are hard-coded
runner.dry_run: plans all materialisation, isolation, and command records without invoking OpenCode
